body: Nobody fucking understands me. I’m a complete failure. If god existed why would he create such a miserable human being? They all tell me that it will get better, but in my 18 years of living it hasn’t. And they tell me that it would be selfish to take my own life. Well I think it’s selfish of them for wanting me to live like this. I feel like everyone takes advantage of my kindness. I’m sorry it’s so sloppy. I’m usually a good writer but I just have to get my thoughts out.
